parameters.name: --host
parameters.description: Address of the Aruba gateway of this site.

parameters.name: --user
parameters.description: A read-only account on the gateway.

parameters.name: --primary
parameters.description: Which uplink kind is the main path: wired or cellular.

parameters.name: --backup
parameters.description: The alternative path: cellular, wired or none. Left out there is none.

parameters.name: --backup-share
parameters.description: Highest share of the traffic on the backup, in percent per interval, before it counts as moved over.

parameters.name: --backup-min-mb
parameters.description: Traffic in MB per interval below which the share on the backup is not judged, 0 to judge every run.

parameters.name: --billing-day
parameters.description: Day of the month the mobile data volume starts over on, 0 for a counter that never resets.

parameters.name: --timeout-ms
parameters.description: Milliseconds to wait for a single answer.

parameters.name: --self-check
parameters.description: Only verify that the sensor is able to run.
